search_space: All C(13,3) + C(13,4) = 1001 feature subsets, matching Latha & Jeeva (2019)'s search space
selection_protocol: Each subset evaluated once on a single inner train/validation split (75/25 of the training fold), beta fixed at 0.1
finding: The feature subset that looked best on a single validation split (0.8667) did not generalize: full repeated 10-fold CV on that exact subset gives 0.7744, substantially below both the no-selection result (0.8417) and the source paper's 0.8548. This is selection-induced overfitting: picking the maximum of 1001 noisy single-split estimates is optimistic by construction, a smaller-scale version of the same test-set-leakage family of problem this project already diagnosed and corrected once before (Section IV). The honest conclusion is that this specific exhaustive-search attempt did not close the gap and should not be used; the 1.31-point shortfall against the source paper's best remains unresolved by this method.
